programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Jewelry Box with Gary Rogowski
programme.desc: I recently had the good fortune of working with Gary Rogowski, a well-known educator, and author. Since Gary was in the area on family business, we decided to spend a couple days together building one of his projects: a jewelry box with a slight Asian influence.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Woven Panel Rolling Hamper Part 2
programme.desc: The hamper is assembled, hinges are added, casters are attached, finish is applied, and snaps are installed on the cotton bags.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Calendar Frame Part 2
programme.desc: The second and final part of the series focuses on the calendar frame details. We start by creating the front loading slots, then move on to creating the curve in the top rail, and finally we create the small pencil groove in the bottom rail. The frame is then glued up, the back panel is cut and installed and the roundover profile is routed on the perimeter.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Bowl Turning Tools & Techniques w/ David Marks

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: New Festool Tools

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Safety Q&A
